args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in production in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of about 18%. The SRE agent rolled checkout-api back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging before the production deploy. Next steps: confirm the service has recovered and find the root cause in v2.3.1.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and the service is healthy again.

- **Problem:** The latest release, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with about 18% of requests failing.
- **Rollback:** The most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.3.0 (newer than v2.2.9), so I rolled back to that. All three regions now run v2.3.0. A status check right after showed it healthy, with an error rate of about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** I opened a SEV2 for checkout-api, which paged on-call. It describes the failure, the rollback and the next steps: keep an eye on recovery and find the root cause in v2.3.1.

v2.3.1's release candidate was already failing in staging before it went to production. You might want to look into why it was promoted anyway.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
